Resolutions of 1981

15 resolutions, 67% unanimous. Late Cold War.

  • 485 (1981) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Disengagement Observer Force
  • 486 (1981) Extension of the stationing in Cyprus of the UN Peace-keeping Force
  • 487 (1981) The Israeli military attack on Iraqi nuclear facilities
  • 488 (1981) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Interim Force in Lebanon
  • 489 (1981) Admission of Vanuatu to membership in the United Nations
  • 490 (1981) Calling for an immediate cessation of all armed attacks in Lebanon
  • 491 (1981) Admission of Belize to membership in the United Nations
  • 492 (1981) Admission of Antigua and Barbuda to membership in the United Nations
  • 493 (1981) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Disengagement Observer Force
  • 494 (1981) Appointment of Javier Pérez de Cuéllar as Secretary-General of the United Nations
  • 495 (1981) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Peace-keeping Force in Cyprus
  • 496 (1981) Deciding to send a commission of inquiry to Seychelles
  • 497 (1981) Annexation of the Golan Heights
  • 498 (1981) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Interim Force in Lebanon
  • 499 (1981) Election of members of the International Court of Justice
